boards.title: ESP32 DevKit (classic ESP32)
notes: Pins work at 3.3 V. Never connect 5 V to a GPIO.
ADC2 pins (marked ADC2) can't read analog values while Wi-Fi is on. Use ADC1 pins 32–39 for sensors.
In code, use the GPIO number, e.g. pinMode(4, OUTPUT).

pins.name: GPIO 0
pins.note: Must be HIGH at power-up. Fine as a button input (the Button example uses it).

pins.name: GPIO 1 (TX)
pins.note: Used by Serial and for uploading.

pins.name: GPIO 2
pins.note: Must be LOW or unconnected while uploading. Good for an LED.

pins.name: GPIO 3 (RX)
pins.note: Used by Serial and for uploading.

pins.name: GPIO 5
pins.note: Must be HIGH at power-up; fine as an output.

pins.name: GPIO 6–11
pins.note: Connected to the flash chip. Using them crashes the board.

pins.name: GPIO 12
pins.note: Must be LOW at power-up (sets flash voltage). Don't add pull-up resistors.

pins.name: GPIO 14
pins.note: Outputs a signal during boot.

pins.name: GPIO 15
pins.note: Must be HIGH at power-up; outputs a signal during boot.

pins.name: GPIO 16, 17
pins.note: Not available on WROVER modules (used by PSRAM).

pins.name: GPIO 21, 22
pins.note: Default pins for Wire (displays, sensors).

pins.name: GPIO 25, 26
pins.note: Can output a real analog voltage with dacWrite().

pins.name: GPIO 32, 33
pins.note: Analog input that works with Wi-Fi on.

pins.name: GPIO 34, 35, 36, 39
pins.note: Input only, no internal pull-ups. Best pins for analog sensors (36 = VP, 39 = VN).

boards.title: NodeMCU / Wemos D1 mini (ESP8266)
notes: Pins work at 3.3 V. Never connect 5 V to a GPIO.
Board labels (D1, D2…) are not GPIO numbers. In code you can write D1 or 5.
The on-board LED is on D4 (GPIO 2) and turns on with LOW.

pins.name: D0 (GPIO 16)
pins.note: No PWM, I2C or interrupts. Connect to RST to wake from deep sleep.

pins.name: D1 (GPIO 5)
pins.note: Default SCL for Wire.

pins.name: D2 (GPIO 4)
pins.note: Default SDA for Wire.

pins.name: D3 (GPIO 0)
pins.note: Booting fails if held LOW at power-up. Fine as a button input.

pins.name: D4 (GPIO 2)
pins.note: Booting fails if LOW at power-up.

pins.name: D8 (GPIO 15)
pins.note: Must be LOW at power-up; booting fails if pulled HIGH.

pins.name: RX (GPIO 3), TX (GPIO 1)
pins.note: Used by Serial and for uploading.

pins.name: A0
pins.note: 0–3.3 V on NodeMCU/D1 mini boards (0–1 V on a bare module). Reads 0–1023.

pins.name: SD2, SD3 (GPIO 9, 10)
pins.note: Connected to the flash chip.
